summary: Board-certified physician with 10 years of continuous full-time experience delivering comprehensive primary care in mid-size regional and community practice settings. Skilled in chronic disease management, preventive care, and coordinating multidisciplinary teams to improve patient outcomes.

experience.title: Physician
bullets: Manage a panel of approximately 2,100 patients, providing continuity of care for acute and chronic conditions including hypertension, diabetes, and hyperlipidemia.
Order and interpret laboratory, imaging, and diagnostic studies; discuss results and treatment plans with patients in shared decision-making visits.
Prescribe and adjust medications, administer adult and pediatric vaccinations, and perform minor office procedures within scope of practice.
Direct and coordinate the work of nurses, medical assistants, and referral coordinators, improving average clinic visit throughput by 12%.
Refer patients to cardiology, endocrinology, behavioral health, and other specialists, tracking closed-loop follow-up within 30 days.
Counsel patients on diet, activity, hygiene, and disease prevention, contributing to a 15% increase in completed preventive screenings.

experience.title: Primary Care Physician
bullets: Delivered full-spectrum outpatient primary care for a diverse urban and suburban population across all age groups.
Monitored patient conditions and progress, reevaluating treatment plans at follow-up visits and through patient portal outreach.
Collected, recorded, and maintained accurate patient histories, examination findings, and care plans in the electronic health record.
Precepted medical residents and nurse practitioner students during clinic sessions, supervising histories, exams, and documentation.
Led a quality improvement initiative on diabetes management that raised the proportion of patients meeting A1c targets by 18%.

experience.title: Physician
bullets: Provided preventive care, health maintenance visits, and same-day acute care for patients of all ages.
Diagnosed and treated common acute illnesses and injuries, ordering and interpreting tests to confirm clinical impressions.
Administered vaccinations and prescribed therapies in accordance with evidence-based guidelines and formulary requirements.
Educated patients and community members on nutrition, physical activity, and chronic disease prevention through clinic-based outreach.
Collaborated with nursing and front-office staff to standardize hypertension follow-up protocols, reducing missed follow-ups by 20%.

experience.title: Physician
bullets: Completed comprehensive outpatient care for an underserved population, including preventive visits and chronic disease follow-up.
Recorded patient medical histories, physical exam findings, and treatment plans accurately and promptly.
Ordered and interpreted routine diagnostic tests and communicated results and next steps to patients.
Referred patients needing specialized care to appropriate specialists and community resources.
Participated in daily huddles with nurses, assistants, and care coordinators to review high-risk patients and coordinate care.

education.institution: a state university school of medicine
